CALLED TO SERVE : Are you involved in ministry in your parish, or interested in becoming more involved?
Join us at Knock Shrine for a day of encouragement, learning and sharing.

Whether you are a Minister of the Eucharist , Minister of the Word, Sacristan, in your parish choir, interested in developing a Sensory Mass, or looking for ways to engage young people more actively in parish life, this day is for you.

WEEK OF WITNESS FOR PERSECUTED CHRISTIANS : One in ten Christians, 220 million people, live in countries where they are persecuted for their faith.

The charity Aid to the Church in Need, which works to support them, is organising a Week of Witness from November 15-22 to highlight their plight With a special appeal for parishioners to pray for the suffering Church on ‘Red Wednesday’ November 18th.
More information at:
www.acnireland.org
